consumer.description: If set, the plugin will activate only for requests where the specified consumer has been authenticated.

consumer_group.description: If set, the plugin will activate only for requests where the specified consumer group has been authenticated.

route.description: If set, the plugin will only activate when receiving requests via the specified route.

service.description: If set, the plugin will only activate when receiving requests via one of the routes belonging to the specified Service.

protocols.description: A list of the request protocols that will trigger this plugin.

endpoint.description: Identifies the upstream protocol and provider for this Route.

specification.description: The protocol specification to inspect. Determines how the plugin parses request and response bodies.

provider.description: Logical name for the upstream service. Used in audit receipts sent to VeriKnox Hub to identify which provider handled the request.

agent_passphrase.description: Passphrase used to decrypt the enrolled data plane identity at runtime. The plugin uses this to sign receipts via the native identity library. Store this value in a Kong Vault and reference it as `{vault://...}` rather than setting a plain string.

veriknox_hub.description: Connection settings for the VeriKnox Hub instance that receives signed receipts and enforces policy.

base_url.description: Base URL of your VeriKnox Hub instance.

http_session_header.description: Name of the HTTP request header from which the plugin extracts a session ID to include in audit receipts. For example, `X-Session-Id` or `X-Claude-Code-Session-Id`. If omitted, no session ID is attached to receipts.
